ContainerRegistryLoginEvents.operations_status: not enumerated in Azure docs (checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/container-registry/monitor-container-registry-reference); columns below are the verified allowlist
ContainerRegistryLoginEvents.operations_note: Read all three service/monitoring docs: monitor-container-registry (how-to-monitor), monitor-container-registry-reference (monitoring data reference), and the Azure Monitor supported-logs page microsoft-containerregistry-registries-logs. None enumerates operation/action values for the Login Events table. In monitor-container-registry-reference the 'Azure Monitor Logs tables' section describes ContainerRegistryLoginEvents only as 'Registry authentication events and status, including the incoming identity and IP address' with no value list; by contrast, the SAME section explicitly enumerates logged operations for the OTHER table, ContainerRegistryRepositoryEvents ('push, pull, untag, delete (including repository delete), purge tag, and purge manifest') - no comparable list exists for LoginEvents. On the monitor-container-registry page OperationName appears only as a projected column in example KQL queries (e.g. 'ContainerRegistryLoginEvents | where ResultDescription != "200"'), not as an enumerated set of values. The supported-logs reference lists only the log category and table (columns), not operation values.
